display_long_description:
You play as a Monke in a strange universe where countless ghosts are hunting you.

Your goal is simple: survive.

Each ghost brings a new challenge, becoming harder and more unpredictable as you progress. Learn their behaviors, find ways to escape them, and do whatever it takes to stay alive.

But there is more hiding within this world.

Explore mysterious locations, discover hidden areas, uncover strange clues, and investigate secrets scattered throughout the game. Some ghosts may be connected to mysteries that haven't been solved yet.

And you won't be solving them alone.

The community plays a major role in uncovering the truth. Share discoveries, test theories, investigate strange encounters, and work together to find solutions to the questions surrounding each ghost.

Some answers may be hidden in plain sight.

Some ghosts may be hiding something.

And some mysteries may require the entire community to solve.

Explore. Survive. Investigate.

The ghosts are waiting.

Will you find the answers before they find you?
